topStories.headline: Alphabet Q2 Revenue Surges 24% but $205B Capex Raise Sends Stock Down 7%
topStories.summary: Alphabet reported Q2 revenue of $119.8B and Google Cloud up 82%, but raising full-year capex to as high as $205B reignited investor concern about the ROI on AI infrastructure spending.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOGL ↓ 7%; Nasdaq Composite ↓ 2.15% dragged by tech; AI capex-vs-payoff debate intensifies across Mag-7 peers ↓

topStories.headline: Tesla Posts Record Deliveries but Profits Implode — EPS Misses by 35%, Stock Falls 14%
topStories.summary: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 (+25%), but GAAP operating income collapsed 57% YoY to $398M with operating margin at 1.4%; adjusted EPS of $0.33 was far below the $0.51 consensus.
topStories.marketImpact: TSLA ↓ 14%; operating margin compression raises questions about EV pricing strategy; energy storage peers under pressure ↓

topStories.headline: Houthis Strike Two Saudi Oil Tankers in Red Sea, Brent Crude Spikes Above $100
topStories.summary: Houthi militants attacked Saudi tankers Encelia and Layla in the Red Sea; five more tankers reversed course after a declared maritime embargo; the US completed its 12th consecutive night of airstrikes on Iranian targets.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↑ ~7% to ~$101/barrel (first above $100 since May); energy sector ↑; airlines and consumer discretionary ↓; inflation re-acceleration risk; US 10Y yield ↑ to 4.71%

topStories.headline: S&P 500 Falls 1.2%, Nasdaq Sinks 2.1% in Worst Single-Day Drop in a Month
topStories.summary: Dual earnings shocks from Alphabet and Tesla, combined with oil surging above $100 on geopolitical risk, drove the S&P 500 to its biggest one-day sell-off since late June.
topStories.marketImpact: S&P 500 ↓ 1.21% to 7,408; Nasdaq ↓ 2.15% to 25,138; Dow ↓ 0.97% to 51,712; Asian equity futures pointing broadly lower ↓

topStories.headline: Uber Cuts 10% of Customer Service Workforce, Directly Cites AI Automation
topStories.summary: Uber laid off 10% of its Community Operations team, stating AI tools have made the current support structure too complex; the move follows a 23% cut to the HR division in June.
topStories.marketImpact: UBER watch for long-run cost efficiency ↑ vs. near-term service quality risk; AI-automation headcount reduction theme accelerates across platform companies

topStories.headline: China Q2 GDP Slows to 4.3%, Weakest Since 2022 — Politburo Stimulus Watch Intensifies
topStories.summary: China's economy expanded just 4.3% in Q2, missing the 4.5% consensus and the slowest pace since Q4 2022, as urban fixed-asset investment fell 5.7% in H1 and private consumption stayed subdued.
topStories.marketImpact: FXI, 9988.HK ↓ on growth concerns; late-July Politburo meeting is key catalyst for H2 stimulus signal; copper and iron ore ↓

topStories.headline: Tencent Tumbles 7% as Gaming Concerns Mount and Buyback Programme Suspended
topStories.summary: Tencent Holdings slid to HK$440.60 after suspending share buybacks and as investors grew wary about slowing gaming revenues and heavy AI capital commitments ahead of August 12 earnings.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK ↓ 7%; Hang Seng Tech Index weighed; buyback removal strips a key price floor; Alibaba (9988.HK) holds up on AI model optimism ↔

topStories.headline: Japan June Core CPI at 1.6%, Below BOJ Target — Rate Hike Still Expected at July 30–31 Meeting
topStories.summary: Japan's June core CPI rose 1.6% YoY, matching forecasts but staying below the BOJ's 2% target for a fifth straight month; headline inflation ticked up to 1.7%; BOJ meets July 30–31.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY watch with elevated BOJ rate hike probability; JGBs steady; 7203.T (Toyota) ↑ on yen softness; energy-inflation base effect fades in coming months
